entities.summary: Derrick Francis Van Orden is an American politician, actor, and retired United States Navy SEAL who is the U.S. representative for Wisconsin's 3rd congressional district, since 2023. He is a member of the Republican Party. Derrick Van Orden was a performers & entertainers from Hennepin County (b. 1969-09-15, Hennepin County). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
